title: Ship the licence and third-party notices with the app and the repository
story: Settings, then Updates, now has a Licences row under Version whose link opens Maestro's licence and the notices for every bundled npm package, Rust crate and the JetBrains Mono font. The licence moved from legal/ to the repository root, and every installer carries LICENSE and a legal/ folder with the notices and the font licence.

checks.criterion: The notices can be opened from the app
checks.steps: Install the build from main and start it. Open Settings, then Updates, and click 'Licence and third-party notices' in the Licences row.
checks.expected: A text file opens in the default viewer, starting with 'THIRD-PARTY NOTICES FOR MAESTRO' and then the MIT licence; tailwindcss and vite are listed.

checks.criterion: A missing notices file is explained
checks.steps: In a dev build (npm run tauri dev) started without ever running npm run notices, open Settings, then Updates, and click the link.
checks.expected: A red line under the row says the notices file is missing from this copy of Maestro.
